ui.operation.param.asset: Path of the asset inside the document; empty means the asset is the document itself.
ui.operation.param.assetId: Asset identifier — a path from the content tree root, not a URL and not a filesystem path.
ui.operation.param.binding: Where the object keeps position and rotation: the component and its field names. A project setting — the core has no notion of position.
ui.operation.param.cellKind: Kind of the cell: plain, ramp or floorless. One kind describes the whole cell.
ui.operation.param.cellX: Cell index along the horizontal axis — a whole grid number, not a world coordinate.
ui.operation.param.cellY: Cell index along the vertical axis — a whole grid number, not a world coordinate.
ui.operation.param.document: Identifier of an open document — a path from the content tree root.
ui.operation.param.entry: Name of the visual manifest entry — the sim identifier the entry is bound to.
ui.operation.param.layer: Layer of the placed thing: "sim" is a scene config placement record, "decoration" is a paired presentation document record. Absent means a sim object.
ui.operation.param.level: Cell level: an integer from the range of the level map.
ui.operation.param.list: Path of the placement list in the document; its records are addressed by session descriptors.
ui.operation.param.offset: Signed visual offset of the cell in sixteenths of the render height step.
ui.operation.param.prefab: Name of the prefab whose instance is placed on the arena.
ui.operation.param.record: Session descriptor of a placement record. Lives only in the memory of the current session.
ui.operation.param.scale: Positive scale multiplier on top of the view record's scale.
ui.operation.param.skin: Skin name of the entry: a named set of texture slot substitutions.
ui.operation.param.slot: Number of the model texture slot the skin substitutes.
ui.operation.param.target: Destination document of the transfer: the member of the pair the object moves into.
ui.operation.param.turns: Rotation as a fraction of a turn: the core's angle unit, where 1.0 is a full turn.
ui.operation.param.visual: Key of a visual manifest record, from either of its two sections: the key space is one.
ui.operation.param.x: World X coordinate as a float; the document receives a quantized value: Q16.16 from the core for a sim object (FP-1), the layer's decimal step for a decoration (PRES-3).
ui.operation.param.y: World Y coordinate as a float; the document receives a quantized value: Q16.16 from the core for a sim object (FP-1), the layer's decimal step for a decoration (PRES-3).
ui.operation.scene.curvature.offset: Writes the visual offset of one cell into the curvature map. It never reaches the terrain sim asset: the map has no channel into the simulation.
ui.operation.scene.decoration.add: Appends a record with a view and a position to the end of the decoration list of the paired presentation document. Append only: reordering records must not be a side effect.
ui.operation.scene.decoration.fromProp: Moves a placement record into the paired presentation document as a decoration of the named view. The position is quantized to the layer's decimal step: the shift is at most half a step, and the round trip promises no byte-exact return.
ui.operation.scene.decoration.scale: Rewrites the scale multiplier of one decoration. The value is quantized to the layer's decimal step; zero and negative values are rejected.
ui.operation.scene.decoration.toProp: Moves a decoration into the scene config initial placement as a record of the named prefab. One operation: an object is never in both documents of the pair at once. Its place on the arena is preserved — the value already sits on the layer's step, and rounding to Q16.16 does not move it.
ui.operation.scene.placement.add: Appends a prefab instance with its position in field overrides to the end of the scene's initial placement. To the end only: record order assigns the issued IDs.
ui.operation.scene.placement.move: Rewrites the position overrides of one placement record. It never touches the list — moving does not reorder records.
ui.operation.scene.placement.rotate: Rewrites the rotation override of one placement record. Unavailable until the project setting names where rotation lives.
ui.operation.scene.terrain.cell: Writes the kind of one cell into the flag map of the terrain asset: plain, ramp, floorless. It never touches the level map.
ui.operation.scene.terrain.level: Writes the level of one cell into the level map of the terrain asset. Cliffs around it are derived by the core from that same map — they have no layer of their own.
ui.operation.visuals.entry.setDefaultSki: Writes the default skin into a manifest entry. The skin must be described by the entry itself, otherwise it has nothing to substitute.
ui.operation.visuals.entry.setModel: Writes the model asset reference into a visual manifest entry. It never creates the entry: an entry is one half of the prefab/entry pair, and creating an authoring subject is a separate action.
ui.operation.visuals.entry.setSkinTextur: Writes a texture slot substitution into a skin of a manifest entry. A skin that the entry does not have yet is created: the substitution is the whole skin.
